content: AI coding agents like Claude Code feature auto-compaction (Claude Code triggers at ~83.5% window). This causes Governance Decay: the model prioritizes task continuity over standing instructions or rules. Soft, deployment-specific rules (like organizational policies) decay 8.3x faster than hard safety rules. The best mitigation is structural constraint pinning (e.g., using CLAUDE.md which is reloaded verbatim each turn, or re-injecting active rules into the prompt).
